content: To conclude this section, unlike many style transfer models which produce text with strong style characteristics (e.g. with strong positive or negative sentiment), often at the cost of preserving meaning and fluency, our model gravitates towards keeping the meaning and fluency of the original sentence intact and mimicking some of the desired stylistic traits.
